semantics.clock: All state changes occur on posedge clk, as explicitly required.
semantics.reset: Active-high synchronous reset has priority and sets q to 32'h00000001 on each rising edge with reset high.
semantics.transition: Otherwise shift old q right by one, inserting zero at bit 31, and XOR old q[0] into indices 31,21,1,0 (one-based tap positions 32,22,2,1).
semantics.initialization: No power-on value is specified; no DUT initialization is added. Defined sequence starts at a sampled reset.
semantics.latency: q is the state updated on each rising edge; no extra ports or pipeline stages.

numeric.arithmetic: Bitwise XOR and logical right shift; no rounding or saturation.

verification.oracle: Per-bit recurrence independently implementing the original one-based taps
verification.sampling: Check after rising-edge nonblocking updates and between edges
verification.coverage: Reset seed, held reset, first transitions, long sequence with both feedback values and all bits, midstream reset, reset pulses without a rising edge, falling-edge stability
verification.failure: $fatal on mismatch; bounded timeout; PASS only at completion

specification_ambiguities.evidence: Original problem only specifies synchronous reset value
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Do not constrain the initial value before sampled reset.
Positions are one-based: position p maps to q[p-1].
